messages:
Jasmine: Hey folks — quick check: can we lock a recurring cross-functional sync for design/RFC reviews + triage? Need someone to own agenda rotation. Prefer short (30m) cadence. Thoughts? :wave:
Ryan: +1. Weekly is helpful while roadmap is moving. Tue 10am PT works for me.
Mila: Tue 10 conflicts with our infra deploy window most weeks. Thu 11am PT would be much better.
Anna: I can take first agenda ownership to get us started — will prep a lightweight template. If weekly is too chatty we could do every-other-week deep dive + weekly 15m triage.
Leo: proposal: alternate weeks — heavy design/RFC deep dive (45m) and lighter triage sync (30m). Keep same slot but mark the calendar as "Deep-dive / Triage". Helps people plan.
jasmine: @Anna that'd be great. Can you post the template? Also need to know who from infra/product/eng-ml should be mandatory.
Anna: will do. Draft incoming in a minute:
Anna: ```Agenda template:
- 5m quick wins / blockers
- 15m RFC/design deep-dive (owner present) or triage items
- 5m decisions & action owners
- 5m parking lot / follow-ups
```
Ryan: for mandatory folks: product PM, owning eng TL, infra lead (mila), and one ML rep (leo). Optional: QA / UX.
Mila: sounds reasonable. If we go with alternating deep-dive, I can commit the infra slot on the deep-dive weeks.
dev-calendar-bot: Poll created -> "Crossfunc sync time" (options: Tue 10am PT, Thu 11am PT, Wed 9am PT). React to vote.
Jasmine: quick decision: agree to alternating cadence + Anna owns initial agenda and doc. Can we also add a short decision-log entry after each deep-dive? simple one-line decisions in the doc.
Leo: yes please — add a "Decision log" section in the doc with timestamp + owner + rationale. Keeps rollbacks easier.
Anna: added Decision log section to the doc: https://redwood.docs/agenda-templates/crossfunc-sync (placeholder). I'll update with attendees for next two meetings.
Ryan: small ask — can we include a quick code-review ping slot? 5m for any urgent PRs that need cross-team eyeballs.
Jasmine: good call. Add under quick wins/blockers.
Mila: casting my vote: :ballot_box: Thu 11am PT (reacted on poll).
Ryan: voted :ballot_box: Tue 10am PT.
Anna: voted :ballot_box: Thu 11am PT (leaning to reduce deploy clashes).
Jasmine: tally looks like Thu 11am PT wins so far. If nobody objects by EOD I'll mark recurring invite and set alternating deep-dive/triage pattern.
Leo: no objections from me.
Mila: no objections.
Jasmine: Decision: recurring cross-functional sync scheduled Thu 11am PT. Cadence: alternate weeks deep-dive (45m) / triage (30m). Agenda rotation: Anna -> Ryan -> Mila -> Leo (repeat). Action: Anna to send calendar invites and post first agenda before Monday EOD.
Anna: got it — will send invites + populate agenda for next meeting.
Jasmine: thanks all :raised_hands:
